A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DynamicCity study and support a complete comparison of text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. Appendices A–E in v2 correspond to Sections 7–11 in v3.

before.justification: v2 reports original reconstruction and generation experiments, ablations, occupancy forecasting results and a 42-participant user study, including appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains the original reconstruction, generation, forecasting, ablation and user-study results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The HexPlane VAE, Projection Module, Expansion & Squeeze Strategy, Padded Rollout Operation and conditional DiT procedures are unchanged. Appendix descriptions of inpainting, outpainting and single-frame conditioning are also retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use CarlaSC, Occ3D-Waymo and Occ3D-nuScenes for the same reconstruction, generation and forecasting tasks. Conditional generation, inpainting, outpainting and single-frame scenarios remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: OccSora remains in reconstruction, generation, efficiency and user-study comparisons; OccWorld-O remains in Table 8; SemCity remains in Table 15. The ablation alternatives also match.

E3.justification: Resolutions, sequence lengths, semantic mappings, evaluation metrics and training settings are retained. Appendix forecasting still uses two seconds of context and prediction, and the user study still uses 20 samples and 42 participants.

E4.justification: Tables 3–5 retain the same component, downsampling and token-organization ablations. Per-class analysis, resource comparisons and qualitative application case studies in v2 Appendices B–C reappear unchanged in v3 Sections 8–9.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting and user-study averages. Neither reports experimental seed variability, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results throughout Tables 1–15 and the qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains CarlaSC 16-frame reconstruction mIoU of 74.22% for DynamicCity and 33.40% for OccSora.

T1.justification: The mathematical content is retained, including Equations 1–13, HexPlane construction, the VAE objective, evaluation definitions, classifier-free guidance and the inpainting update. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims concerning large-scale dynamic occupancy generation, the three proposed components, efficiency and downstream applications.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations remain unchanged. v2 Appendix D and v3 Section 10 retain the same limitations concerning long sequences, training-data coverage, complex traffic interactions and predefined semantic categories.

D1.justification: v3 adds a direct GitHub address for the DynamicCity repository on its first page; v2 provides the project-page address. Both already state that code and models are released. Implementation details and other resource disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 50 cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. Conversion from author-year to numbered citations and relocation of the bibliography are presentation changes.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited copyedits, numbers the appendices as Sections 7–11 and moves references after them. It replaces institutional affiliations with WorldBench Team and removes the acknowledgments. The substantive exposition and section progression remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 extensively redesigns the layout with a boxed title and complete abstract, new typography, wider content areas and resized figures and tables. Figure 1 moves to page 2, and tables are redistributed. All 18 figures and 15 tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The methods, evidence, mathematical content and limitations remain unchanged. The direct repository pointer and consolidated abstract offer modest conveniences, while institutional affiliations and funding acknowledgments are lost. The extensive visual redesign leaves the paper's overall substantive and reporting quality essentially unchanged.
